title: Estrella Immunopharma Appoints Cynthia Pussinen as Chief Executive Officer and Chairperson of the Board of Directors | EstrellaImmunopharma
body_markdown:
***An accomplished biotechnology executive, Ms. Pussinen brings more than 30 years of global leadership experience spanning advanced therapies, clinical development, commercialization, strategic partnerships and capital formation***


***Appointment comes at a pivotal stage as Estrella advances its differentiated ARTEMIS® T-cell therapy platform for cancer and autoimmune diseases***


***Cheng Liu, Ph.D., appointed Chief Scientific Officer; continues as President and as a member of the Board of Directors***


**EMERYVILLE, Calif., October 26, 2026** — Estrella Immunopharma, Inc. (NASDAQ: ESLA) (“Estrella” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation ARTEMIS® T-cell therapies for the treatment of cancer and autoimmune diseases, today announced the appointment of Cynthia Pussinen as Chief Executive Officer and Chairperson of its Board of Directors, effective October 25, 2026.


Ms. Pussinen succeeds Cheng Liu, Ph.D., as Chief Executive Officer. Dr. Liu has been appointed Chief Scientific Officer and will continue to serve as the Company's President and as a member of the Board of Directors.


Ms. Pussinen is an accomplished biotechnology and pharmaceutical executive with more than three decades of global leadership experience, including more than 15 years in C-suite and board-level positions. Throughout her career, she has led the development, regulatory approval, commercialization and delivery of more than 15 innovative medical therapies and healthcare solutions, contributing to products generating more than $5 billion in aggregate peak-year sales. Her experience spans cell and gene therapies, biologics, oncology, rare diseases and other advanced therapeutic modalities, along with corporate transformation, strategic partnerships, capital formation and operational excellence.


Ms. Pussinen's appointment comes at an important inflection point for Estrella as the Company advances its proprietary ARTEMIS® T-cell therapy platform and progresses its lead clinical candidate, EB103, through the STARLIGHT-1 Phase I/II clinical trial in patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (NHL).


Early clinical findings with EB103 have demonstrated encouraging anti-tumor activity, durable complete responses in evaluable patients and a favorable safety profile to date, including no treatment-related serious adverse events in the initial dose-escalation population. These findings have supported advancement into the dose-expansion phase of STARLIGHT-1.


“On behalf of the Board, I am delighted to welcome Cynthia to Estrella," said Cheng Liu, Ph.D., Estrella's President and Chief Scientific Officer. “Cynthia brings a rare combination of public-company leadership, hands-on experience in cell and gene therapy development and manufacturing, and a strong track record of building strategic and financial partnerships. As Estrella enters its next phase of clinical development, the Board and I are confident that she is the right leader to build on the progress we have made with EB103 and the ARTEMIS® platform. I look forward to working closely with Cynthia to ensure a seamless transition.”


“I am absolutely delighted to join Estrella Immunopharma at such a pivotal moment in the Company's evolution," said Cynthia Pussinen, Chief Executive Officer and Chairperson of the Board. “Throughout my career, I have been driven by the opportunity to translate groundbreaking science into meaningful, life-changing therapies for patients. What attracted me to Estrella is the compelling combination of differentiated science, strong early clinical validation and the extraordinary potential of the ARTEMIS® platform to redefine what is possible with engineered T-cell therapies.


“While CAR-T therapies have transformed the treatment landscape for certain cancers, significant unmet needs remain, particularly with respect to response durability, treatment-related toxicity and access for patients who may not be eligible for currently marketed therapies. ARTEMIS® represents an exciting opportunity to address these limitations, with the potential to deliver deeper and more durable responses and improved tolerability. The early clinical results are encouraging, and I believe we have an exceptional foundation upon which to build.


“Equally exciting is the opportunity to extend this innovative technology beyond hematologic cancers into additional oncology indications and autoimmune diseases, where more effective, durable and potentially transformative treatment options are desperately needed. I am honored to work alongside Estrella's talented scientists, clinicians, partners and Board to advance these promising therapies, accelerate clinical development, build long-term shareholder value and, most importantly, bring new hope to patients and families around the world.”


Prior to joining Estrella, Ms. Pussinen served as Managing Director, Biotech Investments at Sorbie Bornholm, where she evaluated and advanced strategic investments in publicly traded biotechnology companies. She previously served as Chief Executive Officer and Board Director of Sernova Corp., a publicly traded biotechnology company developing regenerative medicine and cell therapy technologies. During her tenure, she led a corporate transformation spanning governance, operations and investor engagement.


Earlier, Ms. Pussinen served as Chief Technical Officer at Spark Therapeutics, a member of the Roche Group, where she led global gene therapy development, manufacturing and technical operations. Her leadership helped secure Roche Board approval for an approximately $750 million capital investment supporting advanced gene therapy infrastructure and manufacturing capabilities, while delivering substantial improvements in operational performance.


Ms. Pussinen also served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Ipsen Bioscience and Biomeasure, where she led a major organizational turnaround and oversaw research, development and technical operations. She has held senior executive roles at Pfizer, Honeywell International and Actinium Pharmaceuticals.


Ms. Pussinen has served on the boards or scientific advisory boards of Xelcis Bio, Spes Bio and Spark Therapeutics subsidiaries, and has advised emerging life sciences and healthcare technology companies.


Ms. Pussinen holds a Master of Science in Management of Research and Development from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and a Bachelor of Science in Chemistry, with a minor in Nuclear Engineering, from the University of Connecticut.


As Chief Executive Officer and Chairperson of the Board, Ms. Pussinen will lead Estrella's corporate and clinical development strategy, including advancing EB103, strengthening strategic and financial partnerships, expanding the potential applications of the ARTEMIS® technology platform and positioning the Company for its next phase of growth.


**About EB103**


EB103, a T-cell therapy, also referred to as Estrella’s “CD19-Redirected ARTEMIS


®


T-Cell Therapy,” utilizes ARTEMIS


®


technology licensed from Eureka Therapeutics, Inc. (Eureka), Estrella’s parent company. Unlike a traditional CAR-T cell, the unique design of an ARTEMIS


®


T cell, such as EB103, allows it to be activated and regulated upon engagement with cancer targets through a cellular mechanism that more closely resembles that of an endogenous T-cell receptor. Once infused, EB103 T cells bind to and destroy CD19-positive cancer cells.


**About Estrella Immunopharma**


Estrella is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing CD19- and CD22-targeted ARTEMIS


®


T-cell therapies to treat cancers and autoimmune diseases. Estrella’s mission is to harness the evolutionary power of the human immune system to transform the lives of patients fighting cancer and other diseases. To accomplish this mission, Estrella’s lead product candidate, EB103, utilizes Eureka’s ARTEMIS


®


technology to target CD19, a protein expressed on the surface of almost all B-cell leukemias and lymphomas. Estrella is also developing EB104, which utilizes Eureka’s ARTEMIS


®


technology to target not only CD19, but also CD22, another protein expressed on the surface of most B-cell malignancies.


For more information about Estrella, please visit


[www.estrellabio.com](http://www.estrellabio.com/) .
